channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Dow Jones futures ease as market mood remains cautious
item.description: Dow Jones futures inch lower 0.02%, trading above 50,850 during the European hours on Tuesday, ahead of the US regular opening. However, S&P 500 futures gain 0.21% to near 7,430 and Nasdaq 100 futures rise 0.51%, trading near 29,600 at the time of writing.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Gradual downside toward 0.7000 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann see AUD/USD stabilising intraday between 0.7015 and 0.7065 after a brief dip, but retain a negative 1–3 week bias.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecasts: Pound appreciates to 214,00 but remains vulnerable
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) posts moderate gains against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Tuesday, supported by a modest improvement in risk sentiment.

item.title: United States Dollar Index Price Forecast: Rising 20-day EMA backs bullish bias
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) faces slight selling in the European trading session on Tuesday due to renewed hopes of a potential deal between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: Gold: Uptrend delayed on hawkish Fed repricing – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s FX Strategist Sim Moh Siong reports that Gold has come under pressure after breaking below its 200-day moving average on a more hawkish Fed narrative and oil-led inflation fears.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds gains following China Trade Balance data
item.description: NZD/USD remains stronger for the second successive day, trading around 0.5830 during the early European hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Why is the British Pound struggling when the BoE is considering rate hikes?
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is struggling as mounting political uncertainty and deteriorating economic indicators complicate the United Kingdom's outlook.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Consolidation phase before data – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that risk assets and Asian currencies have stabilised, but expects the US Dollar (USD) to stay supported on dips as markets await key US data and central bank meetings.

item.title: Euro remains stronger against Japanese Yen following German Industrial Production data
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 184.90 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency cross holds gains as the Euro (EUR) remains stronger following the release of Industrial Production and Trade Balance data.

item.title: Australian Dollar picks up amid easing geopolitical tensions, bright data from China
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) posts moderate gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, regaining some of the ground lost last week, although it remains at its lowest level in nearly two months. News that Israel and Iran halted hostilities has triggered a mild relief rally.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar retreats from two-month high as Middle East tensions ease
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, June 9:

item.title: Indian Rupee bounces back as Iran-Israel truce pushes oil prices lower
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) rebounds against the US Dollar (USD) at open on Tuesday after a sharp decline the previous day. The USD/INR pair drops to near 95.50 as oil prices tumble, following reports of a ceasefire between Israel and Iran after the exchange of attacks over the weekend.

item.title: Russian Ruble: Oil-driven gains seen fading into year-end – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose notes that Russia’s central bank has shifted EUR/RUB pricing to derive from USD/RUB, despite thin hard-currency trading. Recent strength in Oil revenues, with Urals averaging about $90 per barrel in April–May, is currently supporting the Ruble.

item.title: Gold extends the range play as weaker USD lends support but Fed hike bets cap the upside
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to gain any meaningful traction on Tuesday and remains confined within a narrow range heading into the European session.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Overall trend appears sideways amid Triangle formation
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades 0.26% higher at around 1.3375 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The Cable gains as the US Dollar (USD) declines amid expectations that the United States (US) could reach a deal with Iran soon.

item.title: Japanese Yen: May weaken toward 160.75 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe USD/JPY as range-bound intraday between 159.90 and 160.40 after a brief spike and reversal, but maintain a slightly positive multi-day stance.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah rises following BI off-cycle 25-basis-point rate hike
item.description: USD/IDR halts its four-day winning streak, trading around 18,070 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Eases from 1.3960 highs with the bullish trend in play
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades moderately lower against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on Tuesday, pulling back from levels a few pips shy of the year-to-date peak, at 1.3966.

item.title: Euro holds losses against British Pound despite stronger Germany’s Industrial Production data
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross holds negative ground near 0.8640 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The Euro (EUR) remains weak against the British Pound (GBP) despite the stronger German Industrial Production.

item.title: Euro: Two month low tests against US Dollar as yields swing – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that EUR/USD briefly touched a new two‑month low near 1.1500 at the start of the week before retracing slightly higher. They highlight concurrent V-shaped moves in global yields and modest curve steepening.

item.title: Germany’s Industrial Production rises 0.4% MoM in April, as expected
item.description: Germany’s industrial sector activity rebounds in April, the latest data published by Destatis showed on Tuesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD trades with caution around $68 as US CPI takes centre stage
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades marginally lower at around $67.90 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The white metal faces slight selling pressure as investors turn cautious ahead of the United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for May, which will be published on Wednesday.

item.title: BoJ set to raise interest rate to 1.0% at June meeting — Nikkei
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) is widely expected to raise its short-term policy interest rate from 0.75% to 1.0% at its upcoming monetary policy meeting on June 15–16, Nikkei reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Euro gains ground to near 1.1550 on ECB rate hike bets
item.description: The EUR/USD pair gathers strength near 1.1545 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday, bolstered by the hawkish stance of the European Central Bank (ECB). Traders brace for the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data on Wednesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen hangs near one-month low vs USD; bears seem hesitant amid intervention risks
item.description: The USD/JPY pair struggles to build on a modest Asian session uptick on Tuesday and remains below its highest level since April 30, set the previous day. Spot prices, however, hold above the 160.00 psychological mark and seem unaffected by a broadly weaker US Dollar (USD).

item.title: US President Donald Trump says he might have a proposal for Iran agreement within days
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that he might have a proposal for an Iran agreement within days, Reuters reported on Tuesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold steadies, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices remained broadly unchanged in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Sticks to losses below $89.00; bearish setup backs further weakness
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – extends the previous day's sharp retracement slide from the vicinity of mid-$93.00s and attracts some follow-through selling during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens above 184.50 with bullish tone despite intervention risks
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross holds positive ground around 184.85 during the early European session on Tuesday. A hawkish stance from the European Central Bank (ECB) underpins the Euro (EUR) against the Japanese Yen (JPY). The ECB will hold its June monetary policy meeting on Thursday.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: New Zealand Dollar steadies above 0.5800 as neutral bias prevails
item.description: NZD/USD gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 0.5810 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Technical analysis of the daily chart suggests the spot price is moving sideways within a rectangle pattern, reflecting a period of market consolidation and indecision.
